citations.quote:
[name="Logos"]停车，前方有异常情况。
[name="Logos"]所有人，做好战斗准备。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#13$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]那是——
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="远处，已经能看到那个名为布伦特伍德的小镇。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n殷红的光芒从小镇的中心腾起，浸染向周围的土地。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n血色的纱幔正轻柔地包覆一切生灵。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_935_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="“司机”"]唔——
[name="“司机”"]——这种感觉，我们之前检修那些法阵的时候也偶尔遇到过。
[name="“司机”"]女妖阁下，这到底是……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]开战之后，谁也没有想到，这片土地被如此迅速地浇灌了这么多的鲜血。
[name="Logos"]……“现代战争”，呵。
[name="Logos"]血魔恐怕已经等到了仪式需要的所有条件。
[name="Logos"]之前那些战地中的晶石仅是与仪式共振的节点，这一路上，我都在寻找仪式的中心。
[name="Logos"]布伦特伍德，这座小镇，在血魔晦暗的计划中，必然有特殊的地位。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#15$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]Logos先生，你能处理吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]这是鲜血的王庭的古老手段，他们也确实为此做了充足准备。
[name="Logos"]我需要更多时间。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#15$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我们还没暴露行踪，也许能争取些时间，但——等等——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#14$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]那是？
[name="阿米娅"]……火光？
[name="阿米娅"]小镇里有交战的火光……会是谁？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_doc_1#1",focus="m")]
看来他们比我们先一步抵达了这里。
一场有些波折的会师。
[subtitle]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="博士看上去很安心。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n是啊，在经历如此之多的艰难之后，我们终于又将和自己的同伴们并肩。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_054",focus="m")]
[name="“矿工”"]女妖阁下，您……要去做什么？您是要处理我们的敌人，对吧？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_054",focus="m")]
[name="“矿工”"]这里，这种力量——难道不是那位血魔阁下，对于全体萨卡兹的赐福吗？
[name="“矿工”"]他……祝福了我们的血脉。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="来自乌萨斯的矿工挥起了他的武器，尖锐的破风声响起。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n他好像有点被自己的这一击吓到了，差点没拿稳自己的武器。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n那位司机小姐和老财先生也凑在了他的身边，研究起了自己力量的增长。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n明椒向我的身边挪动了几步。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_runstop")]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#4$1",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.7)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="明椒"]那个……女妖阁下，我也感觉到自己……似乎变强了一点点。
[name="明椒"]腕力？还是头脑？我自己都不知道，但是总感觉有种……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#14$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]……增强力量的巫术祭坛。我们曾经见过。但无论是规模还是给人的感觉，都远不相同。
[name="阿米娅"]Logos先生，这会不会有什么负面的……
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[name="Logos"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]很意外。
[name="Logos"]并不需要支付代价，起码这份代价，并不是由我们自己的躯体支付。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="明椒"]那您为什么——
[name="明椒"]……
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Logos先生看了这个叫明椒的萨卡兹女孩一眼。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]明椒，对吧。
[name="Logos"]你希望这份力量被用在什么地方？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#14$1",focus="m")]
[name="明椒"]我……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_doc_1#1",focus="m")]
萨卡兹战士们越善战，战场上浇灌鲜血的效率就越高。无论是他们敌人的，还是自己的。
仪式就能够得以延续。
血魔大君已经在为决战做准备了，可是他们……特雷西斯的布置，真的仅仅是这么一个仪式？
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]法阵似乎已经受到了攻击，伴生的血魔造物正在失控。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="是的，大群猩红的蠕虫正在钻出地表，向四周无差别地涌去。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n有不少，似乎嗅到了我们的味道。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#19$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]这里交给我们吧，Logos先生。
[name="阿米娅"]请您先去确认仪式的情况。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]阿米娅，你与博士可以和我一起行动。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="我看了看远处属于明椒的队伍，那几个对危险一无所知的萨卡兹。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#17$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我们会尽快。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]……明白了。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_walkfast", volume=0.7)]
[charslot(duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#4$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_394_1#17$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]那个——
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#15$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]你们打算把我们怎么样？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_394_1#18$1",focus="r")]
[name="阿米娅"]明椒小姐？
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#15$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]我其实之前就发现了，真正被俘的，是我们，对吗？
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#11$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]我太熟悉王庭军的那群家伙了，你们给人的感觉完全不同。
[name="明椒"]你是叫阿米娅，对吧？你和这位博士，才是你们这支队伍的领袖。
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#14$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]你明明……看起来和我差不多大。
[name="明椒"]我能感觉到，那位女妖的地位并不普通，这做不得假。但他为你们效力？
[name="明椒"]前些日子，我还遇到过一位自称是萨卡兹的卡普里尼女士……她也是你们的成员吗？
[name="明椒"]你们到底是谁？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_394_1#18$1",focus="r")]
[name="阿米娅"]你打算和我们战斗吗，明椒小姐？
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="我能感觉到，眼前的女孩没有敌意。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#15$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]我……
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#3$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]……唉，其实我不清楚。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="远处的那几位萨卡兹终于暂时放下了突如其来的力量，向明椒小姐喊了起来。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Dialog]
[name="“老财”"]队长，那位女妖阁下怎么走了？现在我们怎么办？地上的裂缝向我们蔓延过来了！
[name="“司机”"]这两个俘虏怎么被留下了？来自王庭的大人物这么信任我们？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_394_1#19$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#11$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]啊……是啊！你们在那个方向做好警戒！
[name="明椒"]我看着这两个人！
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_394_1#19$1",focus="r")]
[name="阿米娅"]你们的力量也许变强了，但你们并不熟悉战斗。
[name="阿米娅"]或者说，你们谁都没准备好参与这场战争。
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#9$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]……是啊。这么长时间了，我们难道不知道吗？
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#11$1",focus="all")]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_walk_stage", volume=1,loop="false", channel="slide1")]
[stopsound(fadetime=1.5, channel="slide1")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_runstop", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",posfrom="-20,0",posto="-50,0",duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",posfrom="0,0",posto="-60,0",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="我向她靠近了一些。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n不过她似乎误会了我的意思，警惕地后退了半步，随后像是做出了什么艰难的决定似的，又拦在了我的面前。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n这时候我才发现，她其实和我差不多高。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_4071_peper_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[name="明椒"]我是运输小队的队长！如果你们要做什么，就先拿我开刀好了。
[name="明椒"]他们只是从泰拉各地响应殿下号召，卷进这场战争的普通人。
[name="明椒"]他们甚至只是在执行曼弗雷德将军委派的运输任务，完全不清楚自己在做什么——
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_394_1#11$1",focus="r")]
[name="阿米娅"]从他们响应号召起……维多利亚人就不会再认为他们是普通人，明椒小姐。
[name="阿米娅"]这和他们做了什么并没有关系。

contributions.description: 明椒直接向Logos询问并受其调度。
